reasons.emulator:
NPX-1200 (2026-09-16, the project owner's own correction: "pfsense is not juniper. it's
a standalone vendor. if you have old version, then download a new one."):
replaces the old VGA-only pfsense-2.3.3 image (NPX-821's own console: "vnc"
entry, kept below in spirit but now wrong) with pfSense CE's OWN official
"memstick-serial" build - a real, current, free/open-source download (no
vendor-licensing barrier, unlike this project's other vendor images), built
by pfSense specifically for a serial-getty-only boot, no VGA/keyboard.
LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-16 on VM 702 (<test-vm>, netplex-qtest-02, real
QEMU/KVM, not a claim): pfSense CE 2.7.2 (pfSense-CE-memstick-serial-
2.7.2-RELEASE-amd64.img.gz, sha256 bc3ee3d82b8195387114a64c3398505f238a6cb
5393ae9b2d45d1bf9408ed192, from pfSense's own official download mirror
atxfiles.netgate.com - 2.8.x exists on the download page but that mirror has
no memstick-serial build for it yet, checked directly, 404) - real console
shows "uart0: <16550 or compatible> ... console (115200,n,8,1)" and "Dual
Console: Serial Primary, Video Secondary" on every boot, and a real
unattended install (bsdinstall, UFS auto-partition) + interface assignment
(WAN=vtnet0, LAN=vtnet1) produced a golden image that reaches pfSense's own
numbered "Enter an option:" console menu with NO VGA framebuffer involved.
reasons.console:
console: "telnet" (serial), not "vnc" - the whole point of the memstick-
serial build. console_init sends a blank line first since pfSense's console
type prompt ("Console type [vt100]:") accepts Enter for its own default.
reasons.day0_channel:
NPX-1200: real, verified EVE-NG convention (config_pfsense.py on the real
EVE-NG box, <eveng-box>) adapted for netplex's own golden image, which - unlike
EVE-NG's virgin image - is pre-assigned at build time and so boots straight to
the numbered menu with no VLAN/interface-assignment prompt. See
day0_channels.py's PfsenseCdromCopyChannel docstring for the full, live-
verified command sequence and boot evidence.
